description: nf-core/rnafusion context, aligned to the pinned 4.1.3 schema. Gene-fusion detection from RNA-seq (human).

tools.help: Comma list of fusion callers to run (arriba, starfusion, fusioncatcher, stringtie, all). Lab default runs the three main callers.

tools_cutoff.help: Minimum number of callers that must agree to report a fusion.

read_length.help: Read length for STAR overhang calculation.

pipeline.name: nf-core/rnafusion
pipeline.core_rule: Columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, strandedness. Human only. References are a large prebuilt bundle provisioned via genomes_base — not per-resource here.

notes: rnafusion is human-only (species=homo_sapiens, GRCh38). References are heavy (arriba/STAR-Fusion/FusionCatcher/COSMIC) and provisioned via genomes_base; reference_resources is [] because they are not the simple per-file bundle. If no local reference is configured, configure_run reports reference_status honestly rather than implying the run is ready.
